string.text: Each day, native and policy net changes are applied: positive changes are capped at the total limit; negative changes still apply, and existing stock above a new cap is not reduced.

Applies to players and NPCs. By default only city/castle food capacity 1000 is enabled; the other six limits are disabled. Prosperity food consumption remains controlled by its separate MCM switch. Garrison food, sieges, supply, and policy food changes are preserved.
